info.title: Firewall Session
info.description: API to retrieve VSX (Virtual Switching Extension) information for switches.

tags.name: Firewall Session
tags.description: Firewall Session Monitoring APIs to retrieve firewall session logs from a site.

get.description: This API endpoint retrieves sessions logs from access points, CX switches and gateways in a site based on the given client MAC and the filter.

parameters.name: site-id
parameters.description: The ID of the site from which to retrieve the firewall session logs.

parameters.name: start-at
parameters.description: The start time for the query in RFC 3339 format, must be less than end-at.

parameters.name: end-at
parameters.description: The end time for the query in RFC 3339 format, must be greater than start-at.

parameters.name: client-mac
parameters.description: The client MAC of the source device.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description:
OData Version 4.0 filter string (limited functionality). Supports only 'and' conjunction ('or' and 'not' are NOT supported). Supported fields and operators are in the below given table.

| Field | Operators | Required | Type | Default Value | Summary |
| --------- | -------- | -------- | -------- | -------- | -------- |
| `applicationCategory` | `eq` | `Yes` | `String` | `N\A` | `Format is string. Only applicationCategory or webCategory must be set but not both. Also cannot have both applicationCategory and webCategory empty.`|
| `webCategory` | `eq` | `Yes` | `String` | `N\A` | `Format is string. Only applicationCategory or webCategory must be set but not both. Also cannot have both applicationCategory and webCategory empty.`| 
| `deviceType` | `eq` and `in` | `No` | `String` | `('DEVICE_TYPE_AP','DEVICE_TYPE_GATEWAY','DEVICE_TYPE_SWITCH'`) | `Format is a tuple that contains string. Example: ('DEVICE_TYPE_AP','DEVICE_TYPE_GATEWAY','DEVICE_TYPE_SWITCH')` | 
| `deduplication` | `eq` | `No` | `String` | `true` | `Format is string but should only contain values true or false. Returns unique session logs if set to true` |

**The operators are implemented as follows:**

* `eq`: Only values exactly matching the given value are returned.

* `in`: Only values present in the given list are returned.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return.

parameters.name: next
parameters.description: Cursor for the next page of results. Use the value returned in the `next` response field to retrieve the next page. Providing both `next` and `offset` in the same request returns `400 Bad Request`.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The offset of the item at which to begin the response. Providing both `offset` and `next` in the same request returns `400 Bad Request`.
